NAME_ENT/name_ent_caption_disp.why: a2 = 32 from the previous chunk's `addiu a2,zero,32` in the delay slot of the b3 strncpy; the BIOS strlen (0xBFC03494) and strncpy (0xBFC03418) of SCPH-5500 never write a2, so the fifth and sixth strncpy (b4, b5: jal 0x800B4830 with only a0 in the delay slot) copy 32 bytes. On x86-64 n was %edx's garbage: a caption over 128 bytes ran strncpy past the 35-byte b4/b5 and the stack protector aborted the port (explorer card-end_04_saki-s2, NAME_ENT)
